sources.title: koganei_niko_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive DEV_IS]]'s [[Koganei Niko]].

A [[black jacket|black]] [[letterman jacket|letterman]] [[sukajan]] with a [[tiger]] motif, a [[crop top|cropped]] [[black shirt|black]] [[see-through shirt|see-through]] [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[halterneck]] [[cropped shirt|shirt]] worn over a [[black tank top]] with [[criss-cross back-straps]], [[torn pants|torn]] [[grey pants|grey]] [[sweatpants]] with [[knee cutout]] and [[black boots|black]] [[lace-up boots]]. She also wears [[multiple rings]] and has optional [[round eyewear|round]] [[orange-tinted eyewear|orange-tinted]] [[sunglasses]].
